answer: Unlock an identity's vested rewards only as its spending wanders beyond its own funding cluster. If value mostly flows back toward the wallet that seeded it, an echo of the same money, the locked share stays locked. A real agent pays many unrelated counterparties over weeks, the way juniper spreads when birds carry its seeds far from the parent shrub; a sybil farm can only fake that by paying strangers, which leaks the very value it hoped to multiply.
